title: Detectors for Safe and Reliable LLMs: Implementations, Uses, and Limitations

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting ambiguous pronoun-entity references (gender-ambiguity) in text, which may lead to downstream bias during LLM generation.

Training and evaluating BERT-like classifier models on datasets such as Latent Hatred, Identity Groups, and CivilComments to detect explicit hate speech, profanity, and implicit, subtle hatred toward various identity groups.

Generating synthetic training data and utilizing interactive red-teaming prompts (involving deafness, facial scars, speech disabilities, and mental disabilities) to evaluate a detector for social stigma and discrimination.
Using interactive red-teaming prompts focusing on lesbian and bisexual identities to test the social stigma detector's ability to classify harmful and discriminatory language.
Probing generative models and the stigma detector with employment-related scenarios involving Muslim identity to evaluate the detection of stigmatizing or biased text.
